name: @edgegamers/jailbreak-warden
description: The warden: selection, commands, markers, paint, special treatment and peace mute.

hp_equal.description: Guard armor when the first warden is picked and T:CT is exactly the ratio (1-200).

hp_outnumber.description: Guard armor when guards outnumber the ratio (1-200).

hp_outnumbered.description: Guard armor when prisoners outnumber the ratio (1-200).

warden_t_ratio.description: Prisoners per guard considered balanced for the armor buff.

warden_armor.description: Armor for the round's first warden (1-200).

warden_hp.description: Health for the round's first warden (1-200).

warden_maxhp.description: Max health for the round's first warden (1-200).

warden_sound_killed.description: Sound (under sounds/) played when the warden dies; empty disables.

warden_sound_passed.description: Sound played when the warden passes, is fired or leaves; empty disables.

warden_sound_new.description: Sound played when a warden is assigned; empty disables.

warden_queue_seconds.description: How long the warden raffle stays open after round start.

autowarden_flag.description: SourceMod admin flag letters required for !autowarden (empty = everyone).

autowarden_delay_interval.description: Seconds after round start before auto-warden players are entered into the raffle.

warden_open_cooldown.description: Seconds after freeze time before the warden may !open (0-300).

warden_count_cooldown.description: Seconds after freeze time before the warden may !count (0-300).

peace_cooldown.description: Seconds between !peace uses by the warden / chat admins.

max_chickens.description: Chickens the warden may spawn per round.

max_soccers.description: Soccer balls the warden may spawn per round.

marker_customization_flag.description: SourceMod admin flag letters required for !markertype / !markercolor (empty = everyone).

warden_resize_time.description: Milliseconds after placing a marker in which a second ping resizes it.

warden_marker_segments.description: Beams used for curved marker shapes (16-256).

warden_paint_lifetime.description: Seconds each paint segment stays visible.

warden_paint_max_segments.description: Most paint beams alive at once; the oldest are removed first (10-2000).
